request: 强化下方五丈原的书法艺术性。重点重写下排结体、提按、粗细及章法；保留上排逆转与延长走之底。

variants.name: 提按行书
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / localized calligraphic lettering redesign.
EDIT ONLY THE LOWER THREE GOLD CHARACTERS. Preserve the entire upper black “逆转” including its newly extended 辶 long stroke EXACTLY as in image 1. Keep the same upper lettering shapes, position, size, black/gold/red coloring and long sweeping stroke reaching the right. Keep the transparent canvas.
The lower characters are the problem area. REMOVE THE EXISTING LOWER “五丈原” LETTER SHAPES ENTIRELY, and write new gold Chinese calligraphy in their place. The existing lower letters are NOT the desired style reference. Do not trace their outlines. Do not merely change their texture, smooth them, or recolor them.
下方准确文字仅为“五丈原”。在原下排占据的位置，重新题写有书法艺术性的中文行书。三字仍有原来的整体宽度和分量，正确、清晰可辨，大小与高低允许自然错落。
书法重点是结体和提按：主笔与细笔的宽度有约4:1的变化；起笔藏露有别，转折处能看到提起再按下的动作；部分辅助笔轻巧纤细，主笔沉着舒展；收锋干净自然。三个字之间有疏密和呼应，不要像三个等宽粗体字排列。
具体改变：五的横画要有轻重、长短，底横不是一块肥厚平台；丈的横画更轻，撇捺从细到重再提起，形成全行舒展的重心；原的内部要留白，白和小可以有适度行书笔意，外部长撇开张，不能成为厚重屋顶加方框。可以有少量有意义的字内牵丝，不跨字乱连。全部字形为原创定制，不指定已有字体或书法家。
下排表现为真正的二维金墨书法：暖古金颜料写出的平面笔画，少量琥珀金浓淡、微妙暗朱红收锋。ZERO extrusion, ZERO bevel, ZERO cast shadow, ZERO dark sidewalls around strokes. No molded gold, carved lettering, shiny metal block, raised paint or embossed relief. Gold pigment color changes WITHIN the actual stroke, never as thick shaded sides. 金属感不应成为视觉重点。
清楚完整的书法外轮廓，只有极少量顺笔势的细飞白；不要毛刺、裂缝、噪点、泼墨、碎边、油画厚涂和装饰曲线。这次书法感来自字形，不是表面粗糙度。
上下两排依然紧凑，下方三个字不要触碰上方的长捺，也不要缩成小副标题。透明PNG，所有字和收锋完整入画。不要黑底、白底、棋盘格、纸张、印章、编号、额外文本或水印。
Variation 01 — 下排走“提按行书”方向，清晰而雅致。五略扁而紧凑，横画轻入重收；丈的横细、长撇与捺明显粗细变化，左撇轻、右捺沉着后尖收；原略修长，内部横画纤细，长撇与竖钩有弹性。三字高度略有错落，字的中段更加疏朗，轮廓远比原来的铸金粗字轻巧。整体仍稳，具体笔画要像书法家一次亲手写成。

variants.name: 平面金墨
variants.prompt:
Edit image 1. Keep the upper black “逆转” and its long sweeping stroke unchanged. Keep the NEW SHAPES of the lower “五丈原” exactly unchanged, including all the thick/thin contrasts, long strokes, shapes and positions.
Only change the surface rendering of the LOWER THREE GOLD LETTERS:
Convert “五丈原” into FLAT TWO-DIMENSIONAL GOLD-INK CALLIGRAPHY, as if written with a brush dipped in gold ink. Completely remove all 3D relief, beveled facets, shaded side faces, cast shadows and dark brown edge bands from these lower letters. Fill the current dark shaded sides with the SAME GOLD PIGMENT as the neighboring front stroke so each stroke has ONE continuous flat face. No extruded thickness anywhere. No edge highlights or directional lighting. No rendered gold sculpture.
Use a mostly matte antique yellow-gold #C5A05A with extremely subtle pigment density changes, a little soft pale gold #DCC28A within some strokes, and very restrained dark cinnabar tint only on a few far stroke endings. Smooth natural brush pressure defines the shapes; texture is extremely subtle. The new lower lettering should look like a skilled calligrapher wrote with gold ink, scanned the artwork, and removed the paper. No paper is included. No surface embossing, leather grain, hammered metal, cracks, roughness or oil paint.
Preserve exact five-character Chinese text, precise top-row appearance, lower calligraphic outlines, compact layout and transparent margins. Output true transparent PNG with alpha in every gap; no background, no black matte, no checkerboard, no added marks or words.
